notes.title: Farming Fest
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we are taking a part of Farming Fest to show our game! We are working hard right now to complete the game! We also planning join one of the Steam Next Fest in June or October 2024 with demo version of our game and Cocking Fest in November 2024!
Release is planned in November or December 2024, stay with us for more news!

We will be really appreciative for your [b]wishlists[/b] and [b]follows[/b] if you are interested in our game!

Don't forget to also subscribe to our development group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev

And curatorial group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev

If you have any questions feels free to message us at
gosdevproduction@gmail.com
